subject: Renewal & expansion recap: Acme usage, pain points, next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jillian Hayes <jillian@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & expansion recap: Acme usage, pain points, next steps

Hi Jillian / Markus (looping you in for visibility),

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the candid discussion about the renewal and the new workloads you’re planning. Below is a short recap + proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Quick recap of pain points and goals
- Cost pressure on embeddings and high-volume reranking jobs (current patterns spiking at month-end).
- Occasional latency spikes for long-context summarization (~5–8s tail on some documents).
- Need for stronger data isolation / audit logs for the upcoming regulated pilot.
- Goal: Reduce per-token cost ~25–35% while preserving quality, and enable private deployment option for compliance.

Current usage (as you shared)
- Generation tokens: ~12M tokens / month (proportionally higher in month-end batch jobs)
- Embedding units: ~250k units / month
- Active routes: chat, summarization, embedding banks for search

Recommended expansion path (what we discussed)
1) Renewal + Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and consistent latency.
2) Redwood Optimize bundle: intelligent batching/caching + quantization recommendations targeted at embeddings and reranking (expected 20–30% unit cost reduction).
3) Private deployment option (VPC) for the regulated pilot — includes audit logs and KMS integration.

Timeline we discussed
- Decision target: end of April 2026 (so procurement can align for June start).
- Pilot of Dedicated + Optimize: 4–6 weeks after provisioning for tuning quantization and batching rules.

Next steps (action items)
- I will send a usage report (attached) and a proposed pricing worksheet for renewal + expansion by EOD today. [ATTACHMENTS: usage_report_q1_2026.pdf, proposed-pricing-acme-2026.xlsx]
- Jillian / Markus: confirm any additional compliance docs needed (we have SOC 2 Type II summary attached).
- Schedule a 45-minute ops demo for Dedicated autoscaling and a technical walkthrough of caching strategies (Ben to lead).
- We’ll prepare a draft mutual action plan and target dates for procurement/PO.

If I missed anything or you want the recap updated, say so and I’ll revise. Thanks — excited to help make this expansion predictable and cost-efficient.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

> Hi Jillian / Markus (looping you in for visibility),
> 
> Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the candid discussion about the renewal and the new workloads you’re planning. Below is a short recap + proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Thanks for the clear recap, Marissa — this matches our notes. A couple quick clarifications/questions:

1) Can you send the proposed pricing as a redline or summary that shows current vs. proposed line items (I want to share this with procurement).
2) For the Dedicated demo: can Ben show the autoscaling behavior under burst traffic and how fallback to hosted instances works if capacity is constrained? We’d like to see latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99).
3) Compliance: SOC2 summary is great — we also need the data retention policy and whether logs can be retained for 12 months.

Looping in Markus (infra) — Markus, can you join the demo next week?

Best,
Jillian

jillian@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion recap: Acme usage, pain points, next steps

Thanks Jillian — great questions. Quick answers and updated next steps below.

1) Pricing summary: attached workbook (proposed-pricing-acme-2026.xlsx) has a summary tab that shows current spend vs. proposed renewal + expansion (Dedicated + Optimize). I’ll also export a single-page summary you can use for procurement if helpful.

2) Dedicated demo scope: Ben will cover autoscaling behavior (burst scenarios), latency percentiles, and the fallback policy to hosted capacity. He’ll include a short live demo plus a replay of a recent internal test that hit ~3x peak traffic. Suggested slots: Tue 24 Mar 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 25 Mar 14:00–14:45 PT — which works for you and Markus?

3) Compliance & retention: we can retain audit logs for 12 months in the Dedicated/Private plan; SOC 2 Type II summary is attached. For full evidence we can provide the controls matrix and a redacted report under an NDA — let me know if procurement needs that.

4) Pricing / commercial note: if you commit to renewal + the Dedicated+Optimize bundle by 30 Apr 2026 we can offer a 12% expansion credit applied to the first 6 months of usage to help offset migration tuning costs. We’ll formalize in the proposal.

Action items
- I’ll upload a one-page procurement summary by tomorrow EOD.
- Ben to schedule the Dedicated demo (proposed slots above).
- Rishi to coordinate internal discounts/contract terms and draft the mutual action plan.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the one-pager and calendar invite once you confirm a demo slot.

Best,
